paper.title: LingOly: A Benchmark of Olympiad-Level Linguistic Reasoning Puzzles in Low-Resource and Extinct Languages

source_terms: Questions are included with permission of their original authors.
The dataset is for language-model benchmark evaluation only.
Training on the dataset is prohibited.
Distribution is governed by CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; the paper also notes that original authors and UKLO may retain rights to control use.
data_rights.task_specific_handling: Do not publish source data. The official password-protected archives are retained in sources/lingoly. The adapter decrypts benchmark.zip in memory and does not write plaintext JSONL.
data_rights.code_attribution: adapters/lingoly.py adapts am-bean/lingOly prompt and scoring code; changes are identified in its header.

latest_member_timestamp_as_stored.timezone: not encoded in ZIP DOS timestamps; timestamp is recorded verbatim

latest_named_model_response_as_stored.timezone: not encoded in ZIP DOS timestamps; timestamp is recorded verbatim

adapter_method.prompt_source: Official testing/code/load_questions.py load_question function, using the GPT_4o registry entry with its blank chat header and footer by default.
adapter_method.grouping: One case per upstream question group; all original subquestion parts remain together.
adapter_method.no_context: Calls the same official loader with no_context=true; retains the preamble and question sheet while omitting context.
adapter_method.scoring_source: Port of testing/code/scoring_methods.py exact-match normalization and accepted-answer handling.
normalization: Strip leading and trailing whitespace and periods.
Collapse repeated ASCII spaces and lowercase.

published_historical_scores.exact_match_percent: Published exact-match accuracy on the full-context benchmark, by easy, difficult, and overall split.
published_historical_scores.delta_nc_percentage_points: Published score(full context) minus score(no context), by the same splits; these are deltas, not the no-context accuracies.

source_scorer_audit.repository_behavior: The upstream exact scorer gives an empty gold answer 1.0 and does not inspect fuzzy_matching. The paper describes missing and fuzzy answers as excluded, so these code and paper descriptions do not align. This adapter preserves repository scorer behavior; published scores are historical references, not a verified reproduction of the source scorer output.

validation.prompt_and_grouping: 204 full-context and 204 paired no-context cases loaded; 1,133 answer parts retained.
validation.answer_template: Every prompt contains the official blank-answer JSON template; gold values stay separate from prompt input.
validation.json_extraction: Fenced JSON with leading prose extracted and scored against official answers.
